# Synthetic MinerU 3.4.4 pipeline fixture

This fixture is original test material created for this repository. It contains no
third-party paper, lecture note, model, weight, or MinerU program output. The PDFs and
PNG assets are deliberately small synthetic documents, and the JSON was hand-authored
to exercise the stable MinerU 3.4.4 `pipeline` legacy-output contract without installing
or executing MinerU.

Schema source reviewed on 2026-08-14:

- <https://opendatalab.github.io/MinerU/reference/output_files/>
- legacy `*_content_list.json`: a flat reading-order array; `page_idx` is zero-based;
  `bbox` is `[x0, y0, x1, y1]` in the 0-1000 coordinate space.
- `*_middle.json`: `pdf_info`, `_backend`, and `_version_name`; each page carries
  `page_idx`, `page_size`, structured blocks, and raw page-coordinate bounding boxes.

The `native/` case exercises every stable legacy content type accepted by the V2.3
adapter, both supported code subtypes, reference-list handling, captions and footnotes,
auxiliary-item dispositions, exact `middle.json` pointers, and a fully decodable shared
diagram asset. Its table uses the documented Pipeline shape with both `img_path` and
an `<html><body><table>...` `table_body`; the second PNG is a deterministic screenshot
of that table. It also contains synthetic Definition, Theorem, Proof, and Example
anchors so both V2.3 Profiles can run against the same frozen input.
`native-source.pdf` is byte-identical to `native/fixture_origin.pdf`; the PDF and table
PNG are reproducibly generated by `../generate_fixtures.py` using the pinned PyMuPDF
and Pillow dependencies.

The `scan/` case is an image-only PDF with synthetic OCR text in the JSON. Its only
valid outcome is an explicit manual-source-review state; the MinerU records are not an
independent completeness oracle. `scan-source.pdf` is byte-identical to
`scan/scan_origin.pdf`.

`fixture-manifest.json` freezes every public fixture file by SHA-256 and records the
expected normalization inventory. Update it only after intentionally reviewing a
contract change.
